negative.meaning: not active tuberculosis (healthy, or healed post-TB scarring)

excluded.why: Gizli (latent TB) is radiographically silent, so a chest X-ray supports neither answer. Images carrying both a positive and a negative annotation are contradictory in the source and would train as both classes at once.

split_caveat: The shipped train/valid/test boundaries are NOT used: 9,917 images are augmentations of 1,507 base scans, and 699 of valid's 703 base scans also appear in train. The split here is over base-scan groups, so no augmented copy of a validation scan is trained on.

pipeline.implemented_by: offline_cv.preprocess_for_model('tb', img) - the same call inference.py makes, so training and inference cannot drift apart
